Container.Name: HikeLog
Container.Overview: Self-hosted hike log for a household. Log a hike once and every peak list (NH 48, NE 67, ADK 46, 14ers and more), season and person updates: who still needs what, GPS tracks, trail-network completion, stats, and imports from Garmin, Strava or GPX/FIT files. On first start open the WebUI and create the admin account. All data (database, generated secret key, photos) lives in the appdata folder; back that folder up.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, generated secret key and uploaded photos/videos. Back this up.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Address you open HikeLog at, e.g. http://tower:3000 or your reverse-proxy URL. Needed for secure cookies behind HTTPS. Leave empty for plain http://IP:port use.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Optional. Extra hosts (comma separated) allowed to submit forms, e.g. if you reach HikeLog by both IP and name.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Decides which season a hike date falls in.

Config.Name: Allow Signup
Config.Description: true lets anyone who can reach the app create an account. The first account is always allowed and becomes admin.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty: a random secret is generated on first start and stored in the appdata folder. Only set this to use your own.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid: nobody = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid: users = 100).
